paper_title: Search of spin-dependent fifth forces with precision magnetometry
coupling_convention: dimensionless g_e_p * g_N_s and g_e_p * g_e_s
notes: Paper reports two independent monopole-dipole coupling limits at 95% C.L.: g_e_p * g_N_s ≤ 5.7×10^-32 (electron-nucleon interaction) and g_e_p * g_e_s ≤ 1.6×10^-31 (electron-electron interaction). Both limits are valid over the force range λ from ~1 cm to ~300 km, corresponding to mediator masses from ~2×10^-4 eV to ~2×10^-8 eV (via Compton wavelength λ = h/(m*c)). The paper explicitly states these are the most stringent constraints in the ranges 1 cm to 10 m and 10 km to 300 km, improving previous limits by up to two orders of magnitude. The limits are mass-independent (flat) over the stated range, so encoded as horizontal lines spanning the validity region. The experiment uses precision magnetometry with a SQUID-based detector to search for spin-dependent fifth forces mediated by light pseudo-scalar bosons (axions/ALPs). | selector: text (sole candidate)
